learned.title: Lantern money JSON serialization convention
learned.knowledge: Monetary amounts in Lantern must be serialized to JSON as strings using `#[serde(with = "rust_decimal::serde::str")]` to prevent precision loss in clients (e.g., JavaScript). The `arbitrary_precision` feature must not be used as it still results in `f64` parsing on the client side. Tests should verify JSON round-trips using string formats and ensure that parsing JSON numbers fails to enforce the string contract.

learned.title: Lantern money amounts use rust_decimal::Decimal
learned.knowledge: All monetary amounts in the Lantern project must use `rust_decimal::Decimal`. Floating-point types (`f32`/`f64`) are strictly forbidden for amounts to ensure exact, deterministic decimal arithmetic and avoid rounding errors. This decision was formalized as ADR-007 following a rounding incident in batch #4471.
